passages.title: UTBK Lab: Reading Scientific Evidence
passages.text: A school research team tested two methods of growing spinach. Ten pots received water once each morning, while ten other pots received water in the morning and afternoon. After four weeks, the second group was taller on average. However, the second group also stood beside a brighter window. Some students wanted to conclude that watering twice a day caused faster growth. Their teacher disagreed: the groups differed in sunlight as well as watering frequency. The team proposed repeating the study with both groups receiving the same amount of light. The initial result was useful as an observation, but not enough to identify a single cause.

questions.prompt: Which conclusion is best supported by the passage?
choices: Sunlight has no effect on plants
The experiment proved daily water never matters
One group grew taller, but the cause is not yet established
questions.explanation: Perhatikan keseluruhan teks; ringkasan paling tepat harus mencakup topik serta gagasan utamanya.

choices: Sinar matahari tidak berpengaruh pada tanaman
Percobaan membuktikan air harian tidak penting
Satu kelompok tumbuh lebih tinggi, tetapi penyebabnya belum dipastikan

questions.evidence: A school research team tested two methods of growing spinach.

questions.prompt: What else differed between the two groups?

translationId.prompt: Apa perbedaan lain antara dua kelompok?

questions.evidence: the second group also stood beside a brighter window

questions.prompt: Why did the teacher reject a causal conclusion?
choices: The plants did not grow at all
Water and sunlight both differed across groups
questions.explanation: Perbedaan air dan cahaya menghambat penetapan penyebab tunggal.

choices: Air dan sinar matahari sama-sama berbeda antarkelompok

questions.evidence: the groups differed in sunlight as well as watering frequency

questions.prompt: Which new study would best address the limitation?
choices: Remove all water from both groups
Use equal sunlight in both groups
questions.explanation: Menyamakan cahaya membuat perbandingan frekuensi air lebih masuk akal.

translationId.prompt: Penelitian baru mana paling mengatasi keterbatasan?
choices: Menghapus semua air di dua kelompok
Menggunakan sinar matahari sama di dua kelompok

questions.evidence: both groups receiving the same amount of light
